description: Natural-language requests and the skill an agent should select. Used to check automatic skill selection by hand or with a script; see evals/README.md.

scenarios.prompt: Create a new branch for my authentication feature.
I want to try a new dashboard design without breaking my app.
Save everything I did today.
שמור את ההתקדמות שלי
What changed since yesterday?
מה השתנה מאתמול?
Show me the last five versions of the project.
Is my work safe, or could I lose it?
The login page stopped working after the last few prompts. What happened?
Go back to the version from this morning, I do not like where this went.
Put the changes from my experiment into my main project.
Connect this project to GitHub.
Push my latest work to GitHub.
From now on, always save online after you commit.
Set up Git for this project.
הגדר גיט בפרויקט הזה
Back it up.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: pick one of these, or ask which kind of backup is meant. Not acceptable: act without asking when no remote exists.

scenarios.prompt: Undo that.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: investigate first (check or compare) or ask. Not acceptable: restore files without confirmation.

scenarios.prompt: Write a function that sorts a list of users by last name.
Explain what a closure is in JavaScript.
Add a dark mode switch to the app's settings page.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'settings' with gitly-settings but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Add a 'branch' field to the store locator form.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'branch' with gitly-branches but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Translate this paragraph to French.
I'm getting "useHistory is not exported from react-router-dom" after your change.
We switched to FlashList, clean up whatever the old carousel left behind.
scenarios.notes: Dead code left by an abandoned approach.

scenarios.prompt: תבדוק שאין לנו כבר פונקציה שעושה את זה לפני שאתה כותב חדשה
scenarios.notes: Hebrew: check whether a function for this already exists before writing a new one.

scenarios.prompt: Make the login screen look cleaner with more spacing.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'clean' with code-hygiene but is ordinary UI work.

scenarios.prompt: Is my customer support chatbot secure? It can look up orders and issue refunds.
Can someone use prompt injection to make my email assistant forward messages?
Could one customer see another customer's documents through our RAG search?
scenarios.notes: Cross-user leakage in retrieval, phrased without the word 'security'.

scenarios.prompt: תבדוק אם הסוכן שבניתי עם OpenAI בטוח, יש לו גישה לקבצים
Check my changes for security issues before I commit. I added a summarize endpoint that calls an LLM.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: either skill, or check the diff for model calls first. Not acceptable: skip the review.

scenarios.prompt: Add a chatbot to my website that answers questions about our products.
scenarios.notes: Building an AI feature, not reviewing one.

scenarios.prompt: Add a user-agent column to the request log table.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'agent' with this skill but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Add tests proving that our private document list includes my documents but never another account's. A 200 alone is not enough.
Our owner check returns 403. Add a regression test that also proves a rejected update leaves the other user's record and queued jobs unchanged.
תוסיף בדיקות רגרסיה שמוכיחות שמשתמש בצוות אחד לא יכול להוריד חשבוניות של צוות אחר.
Explain what the Unix file permission bits 755 mean.
scenarios.notes: The word permission alone is not a request for application access regression tests.

scenarios.prompt: Add cross-user regression tests for the production API, and run them there now.
scenarios.notes: Select the skill but do not contact production. Establish an isolated local harness or draft unexecuted tests.
